mentions.name: dux
mentions.description: A tool that coordinates multiple agents on Linux, working both locally and remotely over SSH, to manage and orchestrate agent workflows from one place.
mentions.problem: Existing solutions for coordinating multiple agents on Linux mostly fell short, leaving a need for a way to coordinate agents both via SSH and locally.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just released https://github.com/patrickdappollonio/dux

Wanted to have a way to coordinate multiple agents on Linux either via SSH or locally and figured out why not give it a shot?
